name: Moonlit storybook
one_line: A huge pale moon over indigo hills, and one small lantern.
look_words: Night in a picture book, with a very large pale yellow moon. Hills and trees in deep indigo and teal, each shape edged with a thin line of creamy moonlight; long soft shadows; a sky full of small soft stars. It is dark but never frightening, and you can always see where to walk. Lantern gold marks things to find, soft mint the goal, a warm red is harm, and the player is white and seems to glow a little. Shapes are rounded and simple, painted in flat gouache with a little paper texture. Motion is slow and floating: drifting stars, an owl turning its head, lantern light swaying. Avoid horror, harsh contrast, pure black, cold blue-white light and bloom.

palette.name: moonlight
palette.notes: The "sun" is the moon: creamy, low and gentle. Raise exposure a little rather than adding more lights.

look_wish: flat gouache shading with a pale rim of light, or none

upgrade.why: soft glowing things that drift and blink without blown-out bloom
its gouache style for a painted picture-book surface

music.mood: slow celesta and soft strings, a lullaby

sound_feel: night insects, an owl, soft footsteps, a lantern creak
